meta.tagline: Family flight advisor — Book Now, Wait, or Monitor.
meta.description: A personal CLI tool for Australian families that tracks flight prices, computes the true all-in family cost, and delivers one clear booking recommendation per trip.
meta.target_user: Australian family (2 adults + 1–4 children) planning 2–8 domestic or international trips per year

principles.name: One Answer
principles.statement: Every command ends with a clear recommendation. If you want to browse, open Google Flights.

principles.name: Family-First Arithmetic
principles.statement: True cost = base fare + bags + seat selection + infant fees. Never show headline fares alone.

principles.name: Australian-Native
principles.statement: Built for QLD/AU school terms, AU airlines, AUD pricing. Not a US tool retrofitted for Australia.

principles.name: Quiet Unless Actionable
principles.statement: Morning digest: 5 lines. Only highlight trips that need action today.

principles.name: Local-First
principles.statement: All decision logic runs locally. No cloud dependency for the recommendation engine.

features.title: First-run setup wizard
features.description: Interactive CLI wizard that creates ~/.travo/config.yaml with family profile.
acceptance_criteria: Prompts for adults, children (name + DOB), origin airport, state, bags, max stops, alert email
Validates IATA airport codes (3-letter uppercase)
Writes valid ~/.travo/config.yaml on completion
Re-running shows existing values as defaults (idempotent)
Prints next-step instructions including crontab setup

features.title: Family profile view
features.description: Display the loaded family profile including dynamically-computed child ages.
acceptance_criteria: Shows adults, children (name + age as of today), origin, state, bags, blocked airlines
Child ages computed from DOB at display time, not stored statically
Note shown when a child crosses age-2 boundary before travel date

features.title: Data version check
features.description: Show embedded airline database and school holiday data freshness.
acceptance_criteria: Shows data version, last updated date, and list of airline IATA codes
Shows which states have school holiday data
Warns if data version is older than 180 days
No network call — reads from embedded JSON/YAML only

features.title: Date window scouting
features.description: Sample cheapest travel windows across a requested month before committing to dates.
acceptance_criteria: travo scout BNE SYD --month jul-2026 returns ≥8 sampled date windows
Output table: date range, true family cost, airline, stops, depart time, holiday flag
Sorted by true family cost ascending
School holiday periods highlighted
Read-only — no database writes

features.title: Flexible date scouting
features.description: Scout ±N days around specific dates to find pricing differences from minor date shifts.
acceptance_criteria: --flex N shows all ±N day combinations around the base dates
True family cost and holiday overlap per combination
Best option highlighted (lowest cost + no holiday overlap)
Maximum ±7 day flexibility supported

features.title: Start tracking a trip
features.description: Create a trip record and trigger an immediate first price fetch.
acceptance_criteria: Creates Trip row in SQLite with is_active=1
Triggers immediate price fetch on watch (not deferred)
Confirms trip ID and label
Warns on duplicate (same origin + destination + depart_date)
--adults, --bags, --max-stops flags override family profile for this trip

features.title: Pause and resume tracking
features.description: Pause or resume price tracking for a trip without losing history.
acceptance_criteria: pause sets is_active=0; resume sets is_active=1
status digest excludes paused trips by default
status --all shows paused trips with PAUSED label
Pausing does not delete price history

features.title: Remove a trip
features.description: Permanently delete a trip and all its snapshots and recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Asks for confirmation showing trip label and snapshot count
Cascades: deletes price_snapshots + recommendations for trip_id
--yes flag skips confirmation
Non-existent ID exits with code 1

features.title: Manual price refresh
features.description: Trigger an immediate price fetch for a specific trip without waiting for the cron poll.
acceptance_criteria: Fetches price and saves new snapshot
Prints new true family cost and change vs previous snapshot
On API failure: logs error, retains last snapshot
Respects tenacity retry (3 attempts, exponential backoff)

features.title: Scheduled cron poll
features.description: Poll all active trips — the cron target that builds up price history automatically.
acceptance_criteria: Polls all is_active=1 trips sequentially
One-line summary per trip: label, cost, change, recommendation
Error on one trip logs and continues (does not abort)
Exits with code 0 even on partial errors
--dry-run lists trips that would be polled without API calls
--no-email suppresses alerts for that run

features.title: Morning status digest
features.description: Concise digest showing only trips that need action today.
acceptance_criteria: Shows only book_now or wait trips by default
book_now trips appear at top, formatted prominently
When nothing needs action: prints quiet 'all fine' message
Runs in <1s — reads from database only, no API calls
--all flag shows every trip including paused

features.title: True family cost calculator
features.description: Compute the full cost a family actually pays: base fare + bags + seat selection + infant fees.
acceptance_criteria: Calculates: base (adults) + base (children at 90% adult fare) + bags + seats + infant
Bag fees: per person, per leg
Seat fees: per seated pax, per leg
Infant (age <2): Jetstar $35 per sector, Qantas $0 domestic
Child (age 2–11): needs seat; no seat purchased for lap infant
Ages computed at travel date from DOB, not at search time

features.title: Airline fee database
features.description: Static embedded JSON database of domestic Australian airline fees and family ratings.
acceptance_criteria: Covers QF, VA, JQ, ZL, TL with bag, seat, infant, and family_score fields
Conservative default returned for unknown IATA codes
Jetstar infant fee field is per-sector (infant_lap_fee_per_sector_aud)
Virgin lite vs choice fare tiers both represented
data-version shows version + last_updated

features.title: Full trip recommendation
features.description: Single-trip detail: itemised cost, rolling average, trend, recommendation, regret risk, rationale.
acceptance_criteria: Shows one of: BOOK NOW / WAIT / MONITOR
Confidence as percentage, data richness note
Itemised true cost breakdown
Rolling average and trend (AUD/day)
Regret risk: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH
Expected AUD regret for book vs wait decisions
With <3 snapshots: always MONITOR with 'building history' rationale

features.title: Recommendation engine
features.description: Pure-function decision engine: 10-rule priority matrix, trend slope, regret risk, data richness scaling.
acceptance_criteria: 10-rule priority matrix (days_to_departure, price_level_signal, deviation_pct, trend, holiday)
confidence = base × (0.5 + 0.5 × min(n/10, 1.0))
trend_slope via least-squares linear regression, no numpy
Regret: p_drop × volatility × 1.5 for book; p_rise × volatility × 1.5 for wait
All math in pure Python stdlib
School holiday raises wait threshold when dates are fixed

features.title: Side-by-side trip comparison
features.description: Compare 2–3 trips in a table with best value highlighted per column.
acceptance_criteria: Columns: label, true cost, airline, stops, depart time, recommendation, family score
Best value per column highlighted
2–3 trips maximum
Snapshot-tested via Syrupy

features.title: Price history sparkline
features.description: Chronological price history table with Unicode block sparkline.
acceptance_criteria: Table: date, true cost, change from previous, price level signal, airline, source
Unicode sparkline of price trend (block characters)
Most recent at bottom
--limit N shows last N snapshots (default 30)

features.title: QLD school holiday awareness
features.description: Flag school holiday overlap in every trip evaluation using embedded YAML data.
acceptance_criteria: Detects QLD 2025–2027 holiday periods from embedded YAML
Returns overlap_days, is_fully_within, label
Date shift tip shown for partial overlaps
No network call — embedded data only

features.title: Book-now email alert
features.description: Send email when poll produces a book_now recommendation not yet alerted.
acceptance_criteria: Sent automatically at end of travo poll for book_now + email_sent=0
Subject: [Travo] Book Now — {label}
Body includes route, cost, confidence, regret risk, rationale
email_sent=1 set after send to prevent duplicate alerts
New book_now recommendation row generates a new alert

features.title: Pluggy price source plugin system
features.description: Pluggy-based plugin architecture so new price sources can be added without touching core logic.
acceptance_criteria: hookspecs: source_name(), supports_route(), search_flights()
PriceSourceError raised on connection/auth failures
build_plugin_manager() returns configured manager
Multiple sources registered; first successful result used per route

features.title: Tequila API adapter
features.description: Kiwi.com Tequila API Pluggy plugin — primary domestic Australian flight source.
acceptance_criteria: Implements all three hookspec methods
supports_route() returns True for all routes
tenacity retry: 3 attempts, exponential backoff 2–10s
Parses price, airline_code, departure_time, stops, duration_minutes
PriceSourceError on HTTP 4xx/5xx or connection error

features.title: Family flight score
features.description: Composite 0–100 score for ranking flights by family suitability beyond true cost.
acceptance_criteria: Weights: true cost (40%) + stops (25%) + departure time quality (15%) + airline family rating (20%)
Nonstop = 100 stops score; 1 stop = 60; 2+ = 20
Departure within preferred window = 100 time score; penalty 15pts per hour outside window
Score stored in price_snapshots.family_score

features.title: SQLite persistence layer
features.description: SQLite with WAL mode for concurrent-safe writes from cron + manual CLI.
acceptance_criteria: Tables: trips, price_snapshots, recommendations
WAL mode enabled via PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL
Foreign keys enabled via PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON
delete_trip cascades to snapshots + recommendations
get_unsent_book_now_recs() for email alert selection

features.title: Amadeus price level signal integration
features.description: Amadeus Flight Price Analysis provides LOW/TYPICAL/HIGH market benchmark signal.
acceptance_criteria: AmadeusPriceSource registered as secondary plugin
price_level_signal populated from Amadeus when available
Graceful degradation when Amadeus credentials not set
Signal shown in travo check output: 'Market signal: LOW (below market average)'

features.title: DuckDB + Parquet analytics layer
features.description: Incremental analytics: snapshots → Parquet → route stats recomputed after each poll.
acceptance_criteria: Quarterly-partitioned Parquet for snapshots
Route stats: avg/min/max/p25/p75, school holiday premium, trend
Updated in-process after each poll (<100ms)
travo analytics --rebuild performs full rebuild from SQLite
DuckDB sqlite_scan extension for hybrid SQLite+Parquet queries

features.title: LLM contextual insights
features.description: 3–4 sentence LLM explanation of why prices are at their current level for a route.
acceptance_criteria: Pydantic AI agent returns typed TravelInsight (summary, price_impact, event_type, confidence, sources)
No personal data in prompts (names, DOBs, emails)
Cached 7 days; regenerated on >10% price change
Graceful degradation: LLM unavailable → recommendation works normally
Supports Claude haiku (Anthropic API) and Ollama (local)

features.title: All Australian state school calendars
features.description: Extend school_holidays.yaml with NSW, VIC, WA, SA, TAS, NT, ACT for 2025–2027.
acceptance_criteria: All Australian states populated in school_holidays.yaml
State from family profile selects the correct calendar
data-version lists which states are covered
No code change required — calendar loader is data-driven

features.title: Textual TUI
features.description: Interactive Textual terminal dashboard for navigating trips without running individual commands.
acceptance_criteria: Left panel: scrollable trip list, colour-coded by recommendation
Right panel: trip detail with price history, recommendation, rationale
Arrow keys navigate; Enter expands; R refreshes; Q quits
R triggers live price fetch and updates panel in place
Works in 80×24 or larger terminal

features.title: Evidence HTML report
features.description: SQL-driven HTML report of tracked trips, analytics, and price history charts.
acceptance_criteria: Output: ~/.travo/reports/travo_report_{date}.html
Includes: trips + latest recs, price history charts, route comparison, holiday overlay
Opens in default browser automatically
Generation <10s on typical data volume

features.title: International route tracking
features.description: Track international routes with true-cost and recommendation features.
acceptance_criteria: Amadeus used as primary source for international routes
international infant fees (infant_lap_fee_intl) applied
AUD conversion via Frankfurter API
Both origin state and destination country school holiday flags shown

features.title: Multi-currency AUD conversion
features.description: Fetch exchange rates from Frankfurter API and convert all costs to AUD.
acceptance_criteria: Rates from https://api.frankfurter.app/latest?from=AUD
24-hour cache — not fetched per search
Source currency shown in parentheses alongside AUD total
No network call for AUD-denominated routes

features.title: International school holiday calendars
features.description: Destination country school holiday calendars for NZ, SG, UK, JP, TH, US.
acceptance_criteria: Initial support: NZ, Singapore, UK, Japan, Thailand, USA
Both origin and destination holiday flags shown separately
Embedded YAML, updated with package releases

tech_decisions.rationale: DuckDB has a hard single-writer-across-processes limit. When travo poll (cron) and travo refresh (manual) run simultaneously, only SQLite with WAL mode handles concurrent writes safely. DuckDB is used read-only for analytics over Parquet.

tech_decisions.decision: Tequila API as primary domestic source (not Amadeus)
tech_decisions.rationale: Amadeus has incomplete Australian domestic coverage as of 2026 — Qantas NDC only launched July 2025, Virgin/Jetstar uncertain. Tequila covers all Australian carriers (QF, VA, JQ, ZL) on a free tier for personal use.

tech_decisions.decision: Embedded YAML/JSON for school holidays and airline fees
tech_decisions.rationale: No free Australian school holiday API exists (OpenHolidays explicitly excludes AU). No structured airline ancillary fee API exists. Embedded data is reliable, offline-capable, and update-controlled.
Pluggy provides a clean hook specification pattern that decouples provider implementations from core business logic. New providers register without touching tracker.py or recommender.py.
Multi-provider (Claude + Ollama in same interface), typed structured outputs via Pydantic models, built-in retry, native Logfire integration for observability. Production-stable at v1.63.
10–100× faster than pip. uv.lock is universal across platforms. uv tool install for CLI distribution. uv sync --all-extras for dev setup.
DuckDB recomputes affected aggregates in <100ms in-process after each poll snapshot. No separate cron job needed. Data is always current.

non_functional.requirement: travo status reads from database only — no API calls, completes in <1s
travo check renders recommendation in <500ms (database reads + recommender calculation)
Incremental analytics update after each poll: <100ms
travo poll continues to next trip on any single-trip error — never aborts the full cycle
LLM unavailability does not break recommendation — insights degrade gracefully to None
Concurrent travo poll (cron) and travo refresh (manual) do not corrupt the database (SQLite WAL mode)
No personal data (family member names, DOBs, emails) sent to any LLM provider. Only routes, dates, price data.
Recommendation engine and true cost calculator are pure functions with no I/O — tested without any mocking
Python 3.11+, tested on macOS and Linux (GitHub Actions matrix)
travo data-version warns if embedded data is older than 180 days

pyramid.description: Pure function tests — recommender, true_cost, calendar. No I/O, no mocking.
Real in-memory SQLite, deterministic _StubTequilaSource, no external API calls.
Real Tequila API calls. Requires TEQUILA_API_KEY. Excluded from make ci.
Full CLI invocation with live services. Excluded from make ci.

key_patterns: Session-scoped singleton isolation: module-level _db, _calendar, get_settings cache reset before each session
Deterministic _StubTequilaSource: fixed FlightOffer output for predictable cost assertions
In-memory SQLite engine per test: create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:')
pytest markers for CI fast path: addopts = "-m 'not slow and not e2e'"
Syrupy snapshot tests for Rich terminal output regression detection
LLM eval: Pydantic schema validation + golden fixture LLM-as-judge (Phase 2)
